scope: Post-fix POS/inventory/summary source audit with in-memory storage and VM callback execution; no app source edits.

findings.trigger: A preexisting demo PO cache contains valid JSON [null]. Open Dashboard with a role allowed to view POs.
findings.observed: Actual useWorkspaceSummary hook calls summarizePurchaseOrders and throws Cannot read properties of null (reading status).
findings.impact: The parent Dashboard render fails before the Procurement recovery interface is reachable; module-level recovery is insufficient.
findings.related: The same generic array loader counts HR cache [null] as one employee although HR strict validation rejects it.
findings.limitation: Requires already-invalid cached data. No ordinary UI input that creates [null] was established.

observations.result: Reproduced but not classified as new confirmed bug
observations.actual: Inventory dispatch waiting on a Web Lock still changes stock after the caller session has ended, unlike checkout now accepting AbortSignal.
observations.limitation: The dispatch was requested while session active; cancellation policy is a product decision. No Firebase auth bypass.

observations.actual: isInventoryList accepts stockMin=0, stockHealth replaces it by10.
observations.limitation: No UI edits stockMin and zero may intentionally mean use default. Do not count as confirmed without defining zero behavior.

observations.actual: Discount input allows100 but calculateSale rejects a zero-total sale; invalid totals render as dashes and Complete sale is disabled.
observations.limitation: Free-sale support is a business decision. No invalid sale was committed.

passedReview: Demo/live storage separation remains wired through POS, Inventory, and summary.
Checkout validates current stock inside lock and supports abort on session end.
